adjudication.depicted_input: Panel A directly shows the wild-type and mutant nucleotide sequences used to compute the mutation effect score, i.e. the sequence inputs supplied to OmniNA-1.7B for LL estimation.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is defensible. Atlas rules do not require a separate model box when the route-specific input object is visibly depicted. Here, Figure 5A explicitly shows the mutated and wild-type nucleotide sequences and the formula states that LLs are estimated with OmniNA, matching the evaluation route for saturation mutation analysis. This is not merely a post-hoc performance plot; it is the immediate input representation and transformation used for the model-based score.
